name: TMK Chemical Bhd
overview: TMK Chemical 今年主要推进以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100% 股权的交易，该交易于 9 月签署有条件买卖协议，并已向监管机构申请延长提交相关文件的时间。同时，子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 于 1 月完成一项物业收购。此外，公司与关联方的部分经常性关联交易实际金额超出此前披露的预估上限。
overview_en: TMK Chemical's main corporate action this year is the proposed acquisition of 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, with a conditional share sale and purchase agreement signed in September and an application filed to extend the timeline for submitting related documents. Meanwhile, subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd completed a property acquisition in January.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要推进收购 CCM 全部股权，并处理关联交易实际金额超出预估上限的披露事项。
segments.note_en: The main focus this year is the proposed acquisition of 100% of CCM, along with disclosures that actual recurrent related party transaction values exceeded estimated limits.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就 CCM 收购事项向 Bursa Securities 申请延长提交额外上市申请及股东通函草案的期限。
actions.text_en: Submitted an application to Bursa Securities to seek an extension of time for the submission of the additional listing application and the draft circular to shareholders in relation to the CCM acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露与 KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Disclosed that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions with KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd exceeded the estimated aggregate value by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Batu Kawan Berhad 及 Enternal Edge Sdn Bhd 签署有条件股权买卖协议，以 RM939.9 million 收购 CCM 100% 股权，代价包括约 RM438.5 million 现金及以每股 RM1.9098 发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale and purchase agreement with Batu Kawan Berhad and Enternal Edge Sdn Bhd to acquire 100% of CCM for a total consideration of RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million cash and the issuance of 262,500,000…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将 CCM 收购事项的独家谈判期再延长一个月，从 2026 年 9 月 12 日延长至 2026 年 10 月 12 日。
actions.text_en: The parties mutually agreed to further extend the exclusivity period for the CCM acquisition by one month, from 12 September 2026 to 12 October 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Batu Kawan Berhad 同意将 CCM 收购事项的独家谈判期延长一个月，从 2026 年 8 月 12 日延长至 2026 年 9 月 12 日。
actions.text_en: TMK and Batu Kawan Berhad mutually agreed to extend the exclusivity period for the CCM acquisition by one month, from 12 August 2026 to 12 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 发出不具约束力的意向书，拟以 RM920.0 million 现金无债务基础收购 Batu Kawan Berhad 全资子公司 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 的 100% 股权，并已获对方原则性接受。
actions.text_en: Issued a non-binding letter of intent to acquire 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Batu Kawan Berhad, at an indicative purchase consideration of RM920.0 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, and received BKB's a…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露与 Taiko Bleaching Earth Sdn Bhd 及 Taiko Acid Works Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Disclosed that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions with Taiko Bleaching Earth Sdn Bhd and Taiko Acid Works Sdn Bhd exceeded the estimated aggregate value by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 进一步披露与 RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Further disclosed that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions with RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd exceeded the estimated aggregate value by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露与 RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出此前披露的预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Disclosed that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions with RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd exceeded the previously disclosed estimated aggregate value by more than 10%.

segments.name: 氯碱衍生物制造
segments.note: 子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 于今年 1 月完成一项物业收购。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd completed a property acquisition in January this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 于 2026 年 1 月 30 日完成此前公布的物业收购。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd completed its previously announced property acquisition on 30 January 2026.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟通过收购 CCM 100% 股权，将 CCM 集团纳入 TMK，交易代价包括现金及发行新股。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to bring the CCM group into TMK through the acquisition of 100% of CCM, with consideration comprising cash and the issuance of new shares.
